# Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## 1. Technical Architecture & Tensor Placement

### 1.1 Memory Budget Analysis (12GB = 12,288 MB)

| Tensor Category | Key Names (from `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`) | Size per Layer | Total (52-Layer 31B variant) | Placement Strategy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mamba SSM** | `ssm_in`, `ssm_conv1d`, `ssm_conv1d_b`, `ssm_dt_b`, `ssm_a`, `ssm_d`, `ssm_norm`, `ssm_out` | ~14.2 MB | ~738 MB | **GPU** (Critical path: fused kernel) |
| **Attention QKV** | `ffn_gate_inp` (QKV concat) | ~8.3 MB | ~432 MB | **GPU** |
| **Attention Output** | `wo`, `wo_b` | ~4.2 MB | ~218 MB | **GPU** |
| **MoE Experts** | `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps` (per-expert) | ~16.6 MB × n_expert | ~1.2 GB (31B: ~32 experts) | **CPU RAM** (Overflow) |
| **Shared Experts** | `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | ~8.3 MB × 2 | ~86 MB | **GPU** (Small, frequent) |
| **Router Logits** | `ffn_exp_probs_b` (bias) | ~0.4 KB | Negligible | **GPU** |
| **Norm Tensors** | `attn_norm`, `ssm_norm`, `output_norm` | ~0.8 MB × 3 | ~42 MB | **GPU** |
| **NextN/MTP Draft** | `nextn.*`, `attn_norm`, QKV, `ffn_*` | ~25 MB × 4 extra layers | ~100 MB | **GPU** (Draft only) |
